title: Construct Project Configuration
description: Schema for construct.config.json, the source of truth for project-level Construct settings. Shared and committed to the repo.

$schema.description: Reference to the JSON Schema for this file.

alias.description: The display name for this Construct project instance.

profile.description: The active organizational profile ID. Determines which specialists and capabilities are available.

mode.description: The operational mode of the Construct instance.

mcpBroker.description: Controls the engagement of the MCP (Model Context Protocol) broker.

projectName.description: The unique name of the project. Used for multi-project telemetry and storage.

tenantId.description: The tenant ID for enterprise deployments.

workerBackend.description: The execution environment for orchestrated workers.

store.description: The storage engine for orchestration state and task graphs.

chainOfThought.description: Disclosure of a provider-executed specialist's reasoning during orchestration. 'hidden': reasoning is not requested or shown. 'surface': reasoning is requested and attached to each task so the CLI, MCP, and dashboard display it. 'telemetry_only': reasoning is requested and written to the run trace but never displayed.

enabled.description: Whether to record session traces and token usage.

ingest.description: Strategy for ingesting and indexing project documents.

strategy.description: The primary mechanism for extracting text from files.

fallback.description: The secondary mechanism if the primary strategy fails.

orchestration.description: Determines if intake processing is a simple prompt or an orchestrated workflow.

hosts.description: Granular control over editor and platform adapter sets.

providers.description: Provider-specific settings (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub). Values starting with '$' are interpolated from environment variables.

totalCxMaxMb.description: Maximum disk usage for the .cx/ directory (MB).
